blockers_before_private_match: Live path has no vNext support: it loads ActionRankerMLP with v2 state / v3 action features and pad/truncates; it cannot load the VNextDiagnosticMLP checkpoint.
Live candidate generation (legal_action_candidates) emits only move/switch and no move_tera candidates, so Tera actions cannot be scored or selected live.
Live path does not build live-private-belief-v7 state or legal-action-v5 action features (no resolve_action_impact per candidate), so live features would not match training schema/order.
No candidate->Showdown choice serializer exists for vNext candidates (move / move terastallize / switch) wired to model selection.

model_scoring_latency_ms.note: Model scoring only; excludes live feature generation (state v7 + per-candidate resolve_action_impact), which dominates real live latency.
